svg.title: Layout B_plate_6x4 from above
svg.desc: cubes up to the slit; collimator, grating, camera lens and camera on one solid spectrograph plate; 6 x 4 base plate
svg.text: Layout B from above: collimator on the plate
cubes up to the slit; collimator, grating, camera lens and camera on one solid spectrograph plate; 6 x 4 base plate. Footprint 6 × 3 cells.
Lines: 532 nm laser (green, from the laser to the sample), Raman light at 540 / 610 / 680 nm (from the sample to the camera).
